name: @bloodtrail/security-audit-sdk-core
description: Framework-independent core SDK for Bloodtrail Security Audit Event Contract 1.0.0

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-generated-validator.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:runtime
scripts.validate: npm run generate && npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:types && npm run test:exports && npm run test:compatibility && npm run test:contract-immutability && npm run test:scope
